lines: The snow made everything disappear. I stayed where I could see a lantern.
My toes got cold just looking outside.
The wind pushed snow at the door like it wanted in.
I am okay. I want soup though.
The whole village looked like a blanket, but a scary blanket.
I still remember you trying to take my {stolen_item}.
You want an answer after the {stolen_stack} from the {stolen_container}? Fine. Ask, but ask honestly.
I remember the {stolen_item}. I remember who reached for it too.
<aqua>{theft_witness}</aqua> told me about you stealing {stolen_stack}. Not cool.
<aqua>{theft_witness}</aqua> said you took {stolen_stack}. That story travels fast.
<aqua>{theft_witness_possessive}</aqua> account of the {stolen_stack} has reached plenty of ears. <aqua>{theft_witness}</aqua>
I know what happened at the {stolen_container}. <aqua>{theft_witness_possessive}</aqua> story reached me.
The {stolen_container} has been part of more conversations since you touched it. <aqua>{theft_witness_possessive}</aqua>
<aqua>{theft_witness}</aqua> saw enough at the {stolen_container} for the village to remember. <aqua>{theft_witness_possessive}</aqua>
When you arrive, people stand a little straighter. That is not fear. That is what trust looks like after it has survived trouble.
Your name opens doors here because people believe it should.
People relax when you arrive. That is rare power; carry it gently.
Some players pass through villages like weather. You left roots.
You made yourself part of the village instead of passing through it.
People speak of you like someone whose footsteps belong here.
People listen when you speak here. That is useful. It is also a responsibility.
Respect is useful. Be careful not to spend it carelessly.
People weigh your words because your actions gave them reason to.
Good to see you. The village keeps its doors easier when your footsteps are nearby.
Good to have you nearby. The village breathes easier.
Your footsteps sound familiar in a good way now.
We do not know what kind of neighbor you are yet. Villages learn quickly.
We will see what kind of neighbor you choose to be.
Neutral is not empty. It is the village still watching.
Hello. That is all I am ready to offer for now.
Hello. I am listening, but not leaning closer.
You may speak. I am keeping my caution where I can reach it.
You have a talent for making people check where the exits are.
Every door seems to notice you before I do.
You make the square feel smaller when you enter it.
You want answers? Start with why anyone here should give you one.
Answers are for people who have not made questions dangerous.
You have spent every benefit of the doubt here.
